plain_description.what: Builds a fresh federated tree without the declared category labels, but separately within each source benchmark (so it is source-conditioned, not fully label-free). It uses only training questions on the clean multi-corpus split. It tests whether routing each cell to its best model beats the best single model, beats per-source k-means at matched cell counts, and matches routing by declared labels within 1pp. No judge calls.
plain_description.why: It checks whether the routing gain survives when the cells are discovered rather than declared, and whether the tree beats plain clustering.
plain_description.information: Shows whether label-free discovered cells are useful for routing and whether the tree structure adds anything over k-means. Result: done. Beats the best single model by +1.52pp (thin, interval +0.14 to +2.91). It falls 1.15pp short of declared labels, so it is not equivalent to them. Against per-source k-means the difference (-0.45pp) is within noise, so the tree is not shown to be better than clustering. One draw, one roster.
